title: The Helix Network
summary: Helix is launching the Helix Network! Are looking for opportunities to be civically engaged, collaborate with people, find events and trainings, or just to be informed of your environment? Then join us at the launch of the Helix Network!
body:
# The Helix Network: Connecting People with Opportunities

Helix is pleased to introduce the **Helix Network**, a new initiative designed to connect people with relevant opportunities, resources, and professional contacts, launching on the 1st of December 2026.

The Helix Network is a matching system developed by Helix to bring together individuals and opportunities that align with their interests, professional activities, and needs. Through the network, members can discover people, training programmes, products, and events that may be relevant to their fields of work and professional development.

## How does it work?

The network is accessible through registration on the Helix website. During the registration process, participants can indicate their interests and choose whether they wish to receive communications by email, WhatsApp, or both.

Once registered, members will be informed of and invited to opportunities that match their profiles and interests, helping them stay connected with developments in their professional environment and discover new possibilities for collaboration and learning.

## A network with local and international reach

The Helix Network currently operates across two geographical scopes: **Luxembourg and the international level**.

While the international network offers access to opportunities beyond national borders, the local network remains limited in its current scope. As Helix continues to develop and expand its activities in other countries, the network is expected to grow accordingly.

Our ambition is to gradually extend the network's reach, enabling members to discover opportunities at local, regional, and international levels, tailored to their interests and professional needs.

## Join the Helix Network

We invite you to join the Helix Network and become part of a growing community of people connected by shared interests and professional ambitions once we launch our network.

Whether you are looking to expand your knowledge, discover new resources, meet relevant contacts, or explore opportunities in your field, the Helix Network aims to help you make meaningful connections and stay informed about what matters to you.

**Register today and discover the opportunities waiting for you through the Helix Network.**
